runtime_blockers.detail: Package copyright is retained in /usr/share/doc; held packages are included in inventory. cuda-libraries is metadata-only; cuda-compat driver libraries are covered by the CUDA 12.8.1 driver-library attachment and NGC derived-container terms. OpenSSL notice maps to libssl3t64. Final inventory and gate remain required.

Container builder replaces bundled GNU OpenMP/Fortran/quadmath runtimes with corresponding Ubuntu runtime packages after checking exported symbols. Hashes are recorded and publication checks actual bytes. Matching GCC source is collected.
The exact Intel oneMKL 2025.3.0 PyPI wheel includes Intel Simplified Software License October 2022; its bytes and package hash are preserved. Proprietary source is not required by these terms.
runtime_blockers.optional_provenance: The wheel embeds oneMKL symbols, but exact Intel build inputs/third-party materials used to produce this wheel are not published in the CTranslate2 source archive.
